description: The languages this product offers. Written by the new-project skill from the owner's answer; edit to add or remove a language, then run the checker. 'source' is the language strings are written in first (the checker's reference); 'default' is the fallback for readers whose language is not offered (not the first entry). The list is in the order every language picker shows: alphabetical by each language's own name (nativeName), accents ignored. 'culture' drives plural rules (CLDR, via Intl.PluralRules) and number and date formats. Counted strings take a key per plural category the language needs besides 'other' (key.one; key.one, key.few and key.many in Polish), with the key itself as 'other'.

namespaces.description: Every string in the app's screens, including accessible names.
